About us

Practical guides, written to be used

Casa Editrice Ebook publishes Italian-language ebooks on everyday topics: work, money, study, wellbeing. No useless theory: each guide explains how to do one specific thing.

We publish in PDF, so it reads anywhere and stays yours. Every title has a clear description of its contents before you buy.

How we behave

1Clarity

We write simply and tell you up front what is in each ebook.

2Usefulness

Every guide leads to something to do, not just to read.

3Honesty

No promises of easy money: we explain what works and how much effort it takes.
